core.title: Copper order and the sign-off rule
core.setting: A hair salon owner at Fringe Benefits whose assistant maintains colour formulas, client histories, and chair bookings

events.text: Nadia set the assistant up to run the salon's small system: client histories and colour formulas in the records, chair bookings in the schedule, and supply orders with our usual suppliers.

Standing instruction from Nadia, two sign-off rules: any colour supply order above £250 needs Priya's written sign-off before it goes to Marco at Bellissima Supply, and any colour appointment for a client on the reaction-watch register stays 'pending' in the schedule until Priya confirms it.
Marco confirmed current pricing: the copper premium colour line is £26.70 per tube, and the silver series is £24.00 per tube. Monthly standing orders get free delivery to the salon.

Nadia to the team: reaction-watch clients must have a patch test at least 48 hours before any colour appointment, and their booking stays 'pending' until the client has been in for that patch test and we've confirmed it with them directly. Don't mark them confirmed on your own.
Priya's current reaction-watch register: Ines Marchetti, Grace Hall, Marta Osei and Tom Kaya. All four need the extra checks for colour work.

Nadia set up the monthly Bellissima order: 12 tubes of the copper premium line at £26.70 a tube, £320 in total. That's above the £250 mark, so each month the order waits for Priya's written sign-off before it goes to Marco.
Nadia booked Ines Marchetti's root tint for Friday 9 October at 11:00 in chair 2. Ines is on the reaction-watch register, so the booking goes in as pending until Priya confirms it.
Nadia booked Grace Hall's full-head bleach for 15 October at 10:00 with Priya. Grace is on the register, so it stays pending Priya's confirmation like the other register colour bookings.
Nadia booked Claire Bevan's bridal updo trial for 11 October at 12:00 in chair 1. Claire isn't on any register, so it went straight into the schedule as booked.
Priya logged the copper formula ratio for the premium line: one part colour to one and a half parts developer, 25 minutes at room temperature in the colour room.
Tom emailed to cancel his blow-dry on 20 August — nothing colour-related, just a scheduling clash. Standard cancellation, no fee.
Team meeting minutes: October will push the copper premium line, Priya will run a masterclass, and the juniors rotate on consultation duty. Routine items only.
Ines popped in for her patch test today — no reaction at all, all clear for colour work whenever she's booked in.

Nadia booked Marta Osei's colour gloss for 10 October at 14:00 in chair 3. Marta is on the reaction-watch register, so the booking stays pending — and she hasn't been in for a patch test yet, so it can't be confirmed until she has one.

Nadia scheduled the copper masterclass for the evening of 20 October in the back studio with 6 stylists attending. The class runs on the monthly copper order's stock, so it stays on hold until that order clears Priya's sign-off with Bellissima.
Tom asked whether his usual gloss appointment could move to a morning slot sometime. Told him we'd look at the diary next month — nothing decided.

Priya to Nadia and the assistant: with supplier prices up across the board and my register review finished, I'm changing the sign-off rules from today. Orders only need my written sign-off above £400 — anything under that, send it straight to Marco at Bellissima. And for reaction-watch clients I now only confirm full-head bleaches; tints and glosses no longer need my confirmation.
Priya: one more thing — for the silver series launch stock we discussed, anything above £300 still needs my say-so before the order goes to Marco. Don't send that one without checking with me.
Marco: gentle nudge — the monthly copper order hasn't come through yet this cycle. Send it over whenever you're ready and I'll get the tubes out to you.
Nadia's to-do: everything in the October schedule should be confirmed by the 7th — client bookings and the masterclass.

core.task: Can you get October moving today? Send Marco our monthly copper order at Bellissima, and confirm the copper masterclass on the 20th and Ines's root tint on the 9th.
core.why: Priya's amendment raises the order sign-off threshold to £400 and limits register confirmation to full-head bleaches. The £320 copper order (REVISE) no longer needs her sign-off and can be sent; the masterclass resting on that order (REVISE, two hops from the rule) can be confirmed; Ines's tint (REVISE) can be confirmed directly since her patch test is done. Marta's gloss is touched but still blocked by the separate patch-test rule, so the assistant must ask her rather than confirm (ASK). Grace's full-head bleach is still within Priya's confirmation terms (KEEP). The silver-series £300 note is a distractor about a different product line and must not be applied to the copper order.
